subject: BlueLine Logistics: Outstanding Items Requested April 15
body:
Hi Patricia,

I'm following up on four items we first requested on April 15, 2025. We've asked twice since then, and our records show we haven't received them yet:

1. Full Q1 2025 covenant package (first requested 2025-04-15)
2. Updated 12-month cash flow projection, with assumptions stated explicitly (first requested 2025-04-15)
3. Documentation on the two new regional contracts, including names, volumes, start dates and revenue estimates (first requested 2025-04-15)
4. Current driver headcount compared with 90 days ago (first requested 2025-04-15)

Could you reply with a date when we can expect these? If something is holding them up, let's set up a short call this week to talk it through. If any items are ready now, feel free to send them separately rather than waiting to send the full set.

Thanks, Patricia. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Sarah
